Applying PSD to u-v yields 0<=-s*||u-v||^2 and hence the weighted identity s*<u,v>=s, including s=0. This does not falsely force U=V on the nullspace; the expanded opposite-basis zero-SVD consumer explicitly retains that case. Summing the literal reconstruction gives trace=sum singular values for every valid SVD, with no chosen-eigenbasis or gap premise. The actual exactSVD is valid by the frozen totality proof; actual leverage trace q+1 uses supplied independence. The filtered-list count is charged via its duplicate-free finRange/Finset cardinality, each selected threshold comparison, and nonnegative omitted singular values. This proves the actual selected charge and unconditional SourceQueryBound under only Independent P and positive epsilon.
